description: Edit English and Chinese text for clarity and style: improve concision, structure, tone, rhythm, rhetoric, and typography while preserving meaning, facts, quotations, citations, and necessary authorship or AI-use disclosures. Adapt to comments, articles, and literary prose. Offers diagnosis or diagnosis with a comparison rewrite. Use for 润色、优化表达、 删冗余、调整语气、体裁适配、修辞分析、排版, or requests described as humanize / 去AI味 when the goal is ordinary editing. Does not infer human/AI origin or aim to evade review, detection, or required disclosure.
